title: Denmark Rearms and Rebalances: Security Shift and Economic Caution Define a… · 17 Aug
keywords: Denmark, conscription, defence, NATO, Arctic security, Novo Nordisk, inflation, Danish economy, European security, military reform, cost of living, Ukraine war
notes: Denmark is extending military service to eleven months and broadening conscription, marking one of the most significant shifts in its domestic social contract in decades. At the same time, the country's economy presents a study in contradictions: inflation has cooled to 1.8 percent, yet many households report little sense of relief. Together, these twin pressures are reshaping what it means to be Danish in an era of geopolitical anxiety and uneven prosperity.
